visual: Upright tulip flowers, deep pink outside and pale blush within
water: Regular while establishing and in long droughts
soilWarning: Late frost and exposure spoil the flowers
prune: Barely any · take out damaged or crossing wood in summer
hardinessNote: Hardy in most UK locations; breeder information reports tolerance to approximately -22°C, though exposed sites can damage flowers.
resilience: Cold-hardy and compact · the flower buds still fear a late frost
uses: Small gardens · specimen planting · courtyards · large containers
uncertain: Vance Hooper-bred protected hybrid. Parentage is reported as Magnolia × soulangeana 'Sweet Simplicity' × Magnolia 'Jurmag1'. The OCR fragment '(Jqd)' does not appear to be part of the accepted cultivar name. (Oscar's note.)
height: research said "Approximately 3 m"; written as 3m so the size rail parses.
